description: Planned bounded rigid-part animation with transparent 128x128 Forge frames plus Forge-produced deterministic derived atlases
deviation_notes: Implementation was explicitly unblocked by delegated final orchestration authority while predecessor closeout remains commit-gated. S1-S3 now have a bounded public render_preview animation request, derived freshness-bound rig/pose/clip/frame-plan identities, timed rigid sampling, camera-locked transparent 128x128 source frames, a deterministic derived atlas, the exact source GLB, and public manifest/chunk retrieval proven byte-identical across two fresh roots. The mechanical walk proof and both reference-driven guard candidates failed Kimi visual acceptance and are diagnostic only. Pixel successor-manifest ingestion, reconciliation with the broader forge-temporal-delivery/v1 metadata contract, five production clips, Pixel playback, broader creature topology, and final pack art remain incomplete. Individual PNG frames and GLBs remain independently required source delivery, so atlas-only delivery is insufficient.

sprint.goal: Let an LLM author, inspect, validate, and deliver planned readable rigid-part clips as transparent Forge frames with Forge-produced derived atlas metadata through public MCP.
